figurative_meaning_en: The job or duty of a treasurer
similar_in_english: Being in charge of the coffers
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় তহবিলদারী চায়, কারণ টাকা নিয়ন্ত্রণ করতে ভালোবাসে।
প্রতিষ্ঠানে তহবিলদারীর দায়িত্ব পেয়ে সে খুব খুশি হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He always wants the treasurership because he loves controlling the money.
Getting the duty of treasurer in the organization made him very happy.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali administrative roles, possibly referencing positions in zamindari or colonial treasury systems, where 'tahbil' referred to government funds.
note: Variants may reflect dialectical spelling differences in Bengali.
